senses.gloss: to fasten, esp. (denom. of חֲוַט) to provide a shoe with straps.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:4:5">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵈ</cite> top <he>לא יֵחוֹט ליה מסאניה</he> that he should not make for his (woolen) shoes straps of flax but leather thongs.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:4:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו מֵיחוֹט מסאניה בכיתן</he> (not <he>דכ׳</he>) is it permitted to put flax straps on &c.?
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 25:9">Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 16:15">Targ. Job XVI, 15</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Menachot 37b:13">Men. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דחַיְּיטֵיה לגלימיה</he> he who sewed the trail of his cloak up. Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵃ bot. <he>הוה מְחַיֵּיט וכ׳</he> was doing tailor’s work at &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד כות׳</he> 1) <he>ח׳ ליה מן וכ׳</he> he patched it in one place &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to form a net of straps, plait.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a:13">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>דחַיְּיטֵי בחבלי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דחַיְּטֵי</he>) which they plait with chords &c.
